review.notes: All 24 physical pages word-diffed against the OCR markdown; the 4 code fences are balanced. Dropped footnote bodies 1-4 restored as $^{N}$ paragraphs after their marker paragraphs, following the established phi-series convention; footnote 4's printed '##' glyph was eaten by OCR together with the body. Table 4 (physical page 9, 220 dpi render verified cell-by-cell) glued the two-row benchmark names 'Arena Hard'/'BigBench Hard CoT (0-shot)' and 'Qasper'/'SQuALITY' into single rowspan cells; split back so the value rows align with their benchmarks. The printed chat template '<|user|>\n Question <|end|>\n <|assistant|>' (300 dpi render) matches the OCR code block byte-for-byte, including the literal backslash-n characters and spacing. The arXiv margin stamp and Figure-internal chart axis labels are intentionally absent.
